what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Syria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7418 Iraqi refugees in Syria, 2.7% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1982 to 2025, at war level in some of the years after 2004.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2007 to 2011, fall within that conflict's 2004 to 2025 period.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1981 at 400 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1500000, at the end of 2007.
It fell sharply after the main years of displacement, 2007 to 2011.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Syria.
These are year-end totals for Syria only, reported to UNHCR.
